## Problem and change / 问题与改动

## Verification / 验证

Include requirement IDs where applicable. / 说明实际执行的自检与观察、运行环境及未验证事项。未实际运行不得谎称测试或CI通过。明确区分 Worker 自检与用户手动验收。 -->

## Compatibility and risks / 兼容性与风险

<!-- Note changes to CLI contracts (protocol 4.0 / 7 statuses / FULL-DELTA reports / acceptance), task state, permissions, worktrees or recovery, if relevant. / 说明对 CLI 协议、任务状态、权限、工作树或恢复机制的兼容性影响。 -->

## Checklist / 清单

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include credentials, personal data, runtime task records, or unrelated local changes. / 改动聚焦，未引入凭据、个人信息、运行时任务记录或无关修改。
- [ ] Documentation, templates, and examples were updated where needed. / 文档、指令模板与示例数据已按需同步更新。
- [ ] The verification above distinguishes actual evidence from unverified behavior. / 验证说明严格区分真实证据与未验证行为，无虚构通过。
